messages:
zoe (Marketing): Quick sync — we should pause the benchmark blog + launch tweet until SRE gives final all-clear. Also need status page copy, an embargoed email to enterprise leads, and routing for incoming trial signups that hit the status page. @marc @ellis @rita

marc (SRE): Timeline: partial degradation 14:05 UTC, rollback 14:27, observed healthy at 14:34. Root cause suspected: autoscale config bump causing batching backlog. Investigating permanent fix; monitoring active.

ellis (Growth): For lead routing: any trial signups and demo requests during the window should get a status-tag and be routed to the incident-handling queue. Can we add a short banner to the signup flow linking to the status page?

rita (Support): I can tag inbound tickets with "inc-5011" and add canned replies. Need the email subject + one-paragraph to paste into replies. Also will assemble impacted-account list for targeted email.

carlos (PR): We had the benchmark blog slated for 16:00. Suggest we delay the publish by 24h unless monitoring is stable and postmortem ready. If delayed, we should prep a short note to partners explaining the reason (honest, operational).

zoe (Marketing): Draft status page options — choose tone. React :thumbsup: for Option Clear, :eyes: for Option Reassure, :rocket: for Option Action.

Option Clear:
```
Partial service degradation affecting a subset of API requests between 14:0514:34 UTC. We reverted a configuration change; systems are healthy and under monitoring. A follow-up incident report will be published within 72 hours.
```

Option Reassure:
```
A limited number of API requests experienced degraded performance from 14:0514:34 UTC due to a configuration update. We rolled back the change and services are stable. We are validating metrics and will publish a full incident summary within 72 hours.
```

Option Action:
```
Intermittent errors impacted a subset of requests from 14:0514:34 UTC. We reverted the change; please retry any failed requests. We are monitoring and will publish a post-incident report within 72 hours.
```

yasmin (Legal): Don't say "data loss" or "breach". Use "no indication of customer data exposure at this time" only after marc confirms logs. Otherwise use "no indication of data exposure."

marc (SRE): Quick log check shows no access anomalies so far. I can confirm "no indication of customer data exposure at this time" in 10m once full scan finishes.

zoe (Marketing): Draft embargoed email (hold for CSV + legal/SRE final):
```
Subject: Update: brief service interruption resolved

Hi —
We experienced a brief service degradation affecting a subset of API requests between 14:05 and 14:34 UTC. We reverted a configuration change and systems are currently healthy. We are continuing validation and will publish a full incident report within 72 hours.

If you experienced errors or increased latency, please reply with request IDs or open a support ticket at support@redwood.ai.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Team
```

ellis (Growth): For routing: add CRM tag "inc-5011" and route demo requests to on-call AE queue. Also append a lead note: "signup during incident — follow up with empathy + check logs".

rita (Support): Uploading impacted-account CSV to /shared/incidents/inc-5011.csv now. Will update here.)
